about: What the mod changes in STRAFTAT. Each row is one rule and names the Harmony patches (hooks sheet) that enforce it.

columns.hooks: hooks sheet rows that implement it

rows.description: Every player starts each round holding STRAFTAT's RocketLauncher (Resources/RandomWeapons/RocketLauncher); nothing else
rows.verified_in_game: play-tests 2-4: launcher given and auto-picked up on spawn (Training Range)

rows.description: Item pedestals spawn nothing; weapons cannot be dropped or swapped
STRAFTAT's fire recoil push (AddForce(-forward, playerKnockback)) is off; rocket jumps come from the blast like TF2
Rocket flies at TF2 speed, fires every 0.8 s, bursts on the first surface it touches (1 unit out of it, no 0.1 s grace), explodes with TF2 radius, damage ramp/fall-off and splash
rows.verified_in_game: play-test 8 (0.1.6, 145 rocket jumps): user - 'it's awesome'; after-push horizontal median 15 m/s (was 20.8), hand-back to STRAFTAT within 0.1-0.3 s at walking speed

rows.description: Your own rockets never hurt you (the push still happens)
rows.verified_offline: PredictedProjectile applies RemoveHealth to every PlayerHealth in radius incl. the shooter

rows.description: Every player in the blast is pushed with TF2's DamageForce: damage x scale (others 6, self in air 10, self on ground 5), x1.32 crouched, capped at 1000 u/s; a jump pressed in the same frame as the blast counts as airborne (TF2 FL_ONGROUND), so ctaps and jump-and-fire get the air scale; hull and direction are TF2's: 48x48x82 (62 ducked, feet tucked in the air) and the push points from 10 units under the blast to the hull centre
rows.verified_in_game: play-test 8 (0.1.6, 145 rocket jumps): user - 'it's awesome'; after-push horizontal median 15 m/s (was 20.8), hand-back to STRAFTAT within 0.1-0.3 s at walking speed

rows.description: After a blast push, the player flies with TF2 air physics (gravity, air acceleration/strafing, no air friction) until back to STRAFTAT walking speed on the ground; landing with jump held or buffered (STRAFTAT bhop) jumps straight on and keeps the TF2 flight going; acceleration and friction step at TF2's 15 ms tick (tf2_values.TickInterval), floors only stop falling, and a grounded player is snapped down over dips up to TF2's 18-unit step
rows.verified_in_game: play-test 8 (0.1.6, 145 rocket jumps): user - 'it's awesome'; after-push horizontal median 15 m/s (was 20.8), hand-back to STRAFTAT within 0.1-0.3 s at walking speed

rows.description: The launcher looks and sounds like TF2's The Original (loaded from the player's own TF2): STRAFTAT's mesh hidden, The Original's hand origin on STRAFTAT's right grip under AimStrafePivot, only its own colour texture; fire sound = Weapon.fireClip (The Original's), explosion = the rocket's AudioSource with The Original's blast while STRAFTAT's explosion effects spawn as muted copies
rows.verified_offline: export_original.py + Visuals.cs built; plugin target Weapon.fireClip / projectile AudioSource found in decompiled code
rows.verified_in_game: play-test 8 (0.1.6): user - wall momentum and The Original's sounds 'great'

rows.description: Crouching in the air works like TF2's duck: no STRAFTAT crouch fast-fall, the legs tuck up and the view stays; un-crouching lowers the legs only into free space
rows.verified_offline: FirstPersonController.HandleCrouch/AdjustHeight and the crouchGravity lines of ApplyFinalMovements read

rows.description: Walls clip flight velocity like Source's ClipVelocity; for tuning.WallMomentumTime after a wall hit, running along the wall or wall jumping gets the pre-hit speed back (air only)
rows.verified_in_game: play-test 8 (0.1.6): user - wall momentum and The Original's sounds 'great'

rows.description: Landing from a rocket jump: crouched keeps the momentum as a slide (slowing by STRAFTAT's jumpSlopeDecel per second); standing gets TF2 ground friction (sv_friction 4, sv_stopspeed 100) and ground acceleration until STRAFTAT walking speed, then STRAFTAT movement takes over with no leftover push; on hand-back STRAFTAT's smoothed input, speed factor and pushes are set to what is pressed now; a jump pressed up to tuning.JumpBufferTime before landing hops, keeping at most TF2's 1.2x run speed; 'crouched' means the crouch key is held (InputAction crouch.IsPressed, or isCrouching with toggle crouch), not STRAFTAT's isCrouching, which its ceiling ray can force on
rows.verified_offline: FirstPersonController.BForce/HandleBForce (0.5 s ground stop) read; walkSpeed 7
rows.verified_in_game: play-test 8 (0.1.6, 145 rocket jumps): user - 'it's awesome'; after-push horizontal median 15 m/s (was 20.8), hand-back to STRAFTAT within 0.1-0.3 s at walking speed

rows.description: Movement in TF2's speed range (user, 2026-10-10): walk, sprint and air speed = Soldier 240 u/s, ducked 80 u/s, jump 289 u/s, bhop off the ground capped at 1.2x run speed, STRAFTAT slide and wall/slide-jump pushes x tuning.SlideWallScale, the launcher's own movement/jump factors forced to 1
rows.verified_offline: FirstPersonController speed fields, CalculateMovementInput, HandleSlide, Jump/BForce read
rows.verified_in_game: play-test 8 (0.1.6, 145 rocket jumps): user - 'it's awesome'; after-push horizontal median 15 m/s (was 20.8), hand-back to STRAFTAT within 0.1-0.3 s at walking speed

rows.description: Each player places their own launcher: F8 panel with move/turn/size sliders, hide, 'Centered (TF2)' and reset; saved in BepInEx/config/melty.straftat.tf2rockets.cfg; only the local player's first-person launcher changes, rockets still fire from the camera
rows.verified_offline: Weapon.elbowPivot only rotated by STRAFTAT (position free); DualLauncher.Fire spawns from cam position

rows.description: F8 panel 'Look' (local only): your launcher model (11 TF2 rocket launchers, sheets/models.json), your rockets' model (TF2 rocket, Air Strike rocket, Cow Mangler energy ball, STRAFTAT rocket), the TF2 sounds you fire and explode with ('same as launcher' or any launcher's, a random pick per shot like TF2), colour (RGB + presets), opacity (texture alpha ignored when see-through) and an unusual effect (Unity look-alikes of TF2's Hot, Isotope, Cool, Energy Orb). Everything but opacity, placement and spin is shared (rules.shared_looks)

The kill that wins a set (the take that brings a team to STRAFTAT's RoundScoreRequiredToWin) plays a cam on every player's screen. First a replay of the last tuning.KillCamReplayTime seconds (Replay.cs records every player's skinned bones, shown weapon and look direction, rockets, shots and bursts at tuning.KillCamReplayRate on each client; the replay shows render-only copies while the live players, ragdolls, launchers and rockets are hidden and the live game is held at tuning.KillCamFreeze): seen through the killer's eyes (their recorded camera pose and, for your own view, zoom; their body hidden, their weapon in front) until the killing rocket is fired, then riding behind it; the last tuning.KillCamReplaySlowTime plays at tuning.KillCamReplaySlowRate (user 2026-10-12: show it from the killer's point of view until the last shot). Every camera that draws the world gets the shot (STRAFTAT draws through its death camera once you die); cameras that do not are switched off for the cam, with the recorded shot and blast sounds and effects. Then, live, slow motion (tuning.KillCamSlowMo) around the victim's ragdoll, a fly-in to the killer with TF2's freeze cam sound, a near-freeze (tuning.KillCamFreeze) with TF2's snapshot sound, a white flash and a FINAL BLOW banner, then STRAFTAT's end-of-round screen. Each player can turn it off (and the recording with it) in the F8 panel, or preview it with their own last seconds. Time scale changes are local; FishNet ticks run on unscaled time, and on the host the slow motion also delays the round-end timers, so the end screen follows the cam
rows.verified_offline: GameManager.WaitForDraw/RoundWon, SceneMotor.ChangeNetworkScene, PlayerHealth.ExplodeForAll and FishNet TimeManager (unscaledDeltaTime ticks) read

rows.description: Jump & Snipe slot 2: a near-hitscan bullet (tf2.SniperBulletSpeed) riding STRAFTAT's networked rocket, its slot in the shot id's low bits; STRAFTAT's M2000 aim (right-click any time, its zoom, aim position and scope image), no charge; direct hit only, no push. Headshot = STRAFTAT's Head_Col only (its own guns' rule; the neck box reaches the shoulders - user 2026-10-12: body shots were one-shotting) and always kills. Body shots that kill: 1 or 2, the host's F8 pick shared as Steam lobby data 'tf2r_body' (config Game.SniperBodyShots, default 2; 2 = tuning.SniperBodyDamage per hit). From the hip (not aiming) the shot spreads like STRAFTAT's M2000: its Weapon.notAimingAccuracy as random right/up offsets on the aim, applied to the networked shot direction (user 2026-10-12: no bloom when not aiming)
rows.verified_offline: Gun.cs hip spread (ScopeAimWeapon && !isAiming -> notAimingAccuracy) and BeamGun/ChargeGun headshot (Head_Col) read
rows.verified_in_game: 0.3.x played; 0.5.1 headshot rule, body-shot setting and hip spread not yet played

rows.description: Every player's F8 picks (launcher, rocket, sounds, sniper, melee, colour, unusual + strength) and the weapon they have out travel as their own Steam lobby member data ('tf2r_look' sent only when it changes, 'tf2r_slot' at once and at most 10 times a second), heard through Steam's LobbyDataUpdate callback plus a once-a-second check; other players' weapons then show their pick for the active slot (STRAFTAT guns from their prefab), their colour and unusual, their rockets fly as their rocket pick and their shots and blasts use their sounds. Opacity, placement, spin and melee swings stay local (user 2026-10-12: could not tell when the other player had the sniper or melee out). Received data is checked: ids are short [a-z0-9_] names, numbers clamped, unknown models fall back
rows.verified_offline: plugin compiles against STRAFTAT's DLLs (StraftatRockets.dll 0.6.0); SteamLobby already uses Callback<LobbyDataUpdate_t>

rows.description: A front flip or a backflip on a key (defaults Z / X, both free in STRAFTAT; rebindable in F8 with the weapon spin key, Esc cancels, middle/side mouse buttons allowed, one action per key). Over 0.6 s your view pitches a whole turn (STRAFTAT's HandleMouseLook sets the camera holder's pitch each frame; the flip turns it further, so the gun on the camera turns too and shots go where you look); a press mid-flip goes on for at least one more turn and ends upright. Each flip is shared as Steam lobby member data 'tf2r_flip' (count + direction, at most 10 a second) and every other game turns that player's Hips bone about itself (after animation, undone if the animator skipped the frame), so the body tumbles on enemies' screens; the replay records it. Movement is untouched (user 2026-10-13: front flip / backflip with custom binds, visible on the enemy's screen)
rows.verified_offline: FirstPersonController.HandleMouseLook read (playerCameraHolder.localRotation = Euler(rotationX, 0, rotationZ)); Z and X unused by STRAFTAT's bindings
